seo.title: MJP Kitchens & Electrical – Electrician & Kitchen Fitter in Maidenhead, Berkshire
seo.description: A dual trade company: fully qualified electrician and kitchen fitter. Rewiring, fuse boards, lighting, testing and kitchen installations. NAPIT and Trustmark registered.

hero.lead: We are a professional Kitchen Installation and Electrical Services company with over 16 years of experience in the Kitchen and Electrical Trade.

heading: Two trades,
one team.
services.intro: We are a dual trade company. Any electrical work is undertaken by a fully qualified electrician, and we can also supply and fit modern and contemporary kitchens.

items.title: Kitchen installation
items.text: Our qualified fitter has extensive experience installing all types of kitchens to a very high standard, from top of the range units to less expensive suppliers.

items.title: Refurbishment & worktops
items.text: Kitchen refurbishment, kitchen worktops and granite worktops.

items.title: Rewiring & fuse boards
items.text: We can wire any room of the house, and our electrical services always match Part P regulations.

items.title: Faults & emergencies
items.text: We can help with almost any electrical fault or problem you have, and we offer an emergency service too.

items.title: Lighting
items.text: LED lighting and upgrades, outdoor lighting, and security and emergency lighting.

items.title: Testing & showers
items.text: Electrical testing, electric showers and outdoor electrical wiring.

steps.title: We take a look
steps.text: We talk it through, look at the job and give you a clear quote.

steps.title: Job done properly
steps.text: The work is done with care and the site left clean and tidy.

reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Mat and team carried out a total kitchen refit at our property. Absolutely thrilled with the results , fantastic skilled workmanship and lovely to have around our home . would highly recommend and trust
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Mat responded very quickly out of hours to my message regarding an electrical circuit failure. He tried very hard to diagnose the fault over the phone and arrived as promised the next working day to fix. He was thoroughly honest and efficient, solving the issue quickly and without any fuss. … I have no hesitation in recommending him and he will now be top of my list of tradesmen to call!
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Mat and Callum were both amazing! They are both really kind and friendly and we loved having them over to fit our kitchen. They are both outstanding in the services they offer. We faced a few problems and they were not phased and came up with solutions. We absolutely love our kitchen. I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone!
items.label: Which? review

faqs.a: Yes. MJP Kitchens & Electrical is a Which? Trusted Trader, and you can read all our customer reviews on our Which? page.
Yes. Our electrical services always match Part P regulations and we are NAPIT and Trustmark registered.

faqs.q: Do you offer an emergency service?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer an emergency service for electrical faults, and our turnaround time is usually very fast.

faqs.q: Can you do the kitchen and the electrics?
faqs.a: Yes. We are a dual trade company, so we can fit your kitchen and do the electrical work too.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Use the quote form on this page or call 07760 126436. A few photos of the job help us give you an accurate price.
